summary: A valid master whose 9:16 variant crops the product out of frame. The delivery variant owns the defect; the master is untouched.
prompt: A 16:9 master has passed creative evaluation and technical QC. Its 9:16 social variant, derived by a centre crop, loses the product on the left third of frame in two shots. Diagnose: owning artifact, one corrective action, correction scope, and the command the fix routes to. State whether the master or any shot may be touched.
